collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager tries to juggle three small fruits at once.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) tries to juggle three small fruits at once. Two stay in the air for a whole count of five, a personal best.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) tries to juggle three small fruits at once. One fruit lands squarely on (name1)'s head, and the onlookers cheer anyway.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) tries to juggle three small fruits at once. A child asks to be taught, and soon fruit is falling everywhere.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) tries to juggle three small fruits at once. (name1) gives up and eats the fruit instead.
